summary: Normal form transfers by besselU_mul and inv; leading minors and 𝗀 are unchanged.

steps.claim: For rational u, u' ∈ 𝖴 and γ: IsNormalForm(j, u⁻¹γu') implies IsNormalForm(j, γ) (multiply on the left by u, invert, multiply on the left by u', invert: besselU_mul and inv), and conversely (the same with u⁻¹ and u'⁻¹); the leading minors of Z and the discriminant 𝗀 are unchanged under γ ↦ u⁻¹γu' (leadingMinor_frameGram_besselU_mul, frameDisc_frameGram_besselU_mul). So HasLevel(j, u⁻¹γu') ⟺ HasLevel(j, γ).
steps.lean:
lemma Filling.isStable_hasLevel j : S.IsStable {γ | S.HasLevel j γ} := fun _ a _ b _ ↦ .and ⟨(by
  simpa [mul_assoc] using ·.besselU_mul a |>.inv.besselU_mul b |>.inv),
  (·.besselU_mul (inv_mem a) |>.inv.besselU_mul (inv_mem b)
  |>.inv)⟩ (by simp [leadingMinor_frameGram_besselU_mul, frameDisc_frameGram_besselU_mul, *])
